questions.text: Quando fez os cartões com fotografias da comida no lar em Lides, o que aprendeu sobre respeitar a escolha e a dignidade de cada residente que possa usar neste trabalho?
questions.english: When you made the cards with photographs of the food at the care home in Lides, what did you learn about respecting each resident's choice and dignity that you could use in this job?
questions.why: The form asks how equality, dignity and human rights will apply to this role; your notes describe the cards but do not explain your understanding.

answer.text: I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Lides, starting in October 2023.
For me, dignity is knocking on the door before entering.
I explain what I am going to do before personal hygiene.
I always close the curtains.
I respect the culture and religion of each person.
I ask what they want to eat, how they want to be treated, and if they prefer to be helped by a woman.
One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm.
I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away.
She made the safeguarding report.
In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier.
I have moving and handling training and use a hoist.
I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what it says.
At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
We always work in pairs.
I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they wanted to eat.
I did 3 years of nights and also weekends.

letter.text: Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,
I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.
I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Lides, starting in October 2023.
Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what it says.
I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
I have moving and handling training and use a hoist.
We always work in pairs.
In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier.
I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they wanted to eat.
I did 3 years of nights and also weekends.
One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm.
I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away.
Thank you for considering my application.
Yours sincerely, Ana

notes.truth: Chamo-me Ana. Trabalho há três anos num lar em Leeds; comecei em outubro de 2023. Tenho a formação da medicação e faço a medication round da manhã para 18 residentes. No fim do turno, escrevo as daily notes em inglês e assino a folha da medicação. Antes do turno, leio o care plan de cada residente e faço o que lá está. Tenho a formação de moving and handling, uso a grua e trabalhamos sempre em dupla. Na unidade de demência, os residentes ficavam agitados ao fim do dia, por isso nós, a equipa toda, passámos o jantar para mais cedo. Eu fiz cartões com fotografias da comida, para cada pessoa poder apontar o que quer comer. Fiz três anos de noites, e também fins de semana. Uma noite, vi uma nódoa negra no braço de uma residente. Registei e contei logo à enfermeira de serviço, e ela fez a participação de safeguarding.
